locator: Figure 2A top and bottom, and Results pp. 9764–9765
preparation: Recombinant rat SK2 in inside-out oocyte patches. The untreated gray traces were used. Pairing of individual patches between panels was unspecified.
final_bath: Both pulses ended in the EGTA-buffered solution without added calcium. Residual free calcium during washout was unmeasured.
reading: In each untreated trace, measured time from the end of the calcium bar to baseline plus 1/e of the pre-wash excursion. The time bar is 200 ms.
precision_scope: Graph-reading allowance only. No absolute low-pulse group mean or uncertainty was reported.
